preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or become owner through social engineering/compromise)
Contract must have accumulated tax tokens from trading fees

exploit_hint: As owner, call setWallets() to change tax recipient addresses to attacker-controlled addresses. Then trigger contractSwap() by selling tokens to accumulate ETH in contract, which will be distributed to the new attacker-controlled wallets. Alternatively, use setExcludedFromFees() to exclude attacker from fees, then trade without paying taxes. Also consider using setTaxesBuy/setTaxesSell() to set taxes to 0% for attacker's trades.
